scenario.title: a sustained rise
scenario.summary: demand has run about 16% higher for a week, after the rosters were fixed.
scenario.description: Simulated calls for an invented contact centre, with all calls raised by about 16% over the last seven days and two topics raised more.

source.name: Invented data
source.caveat: Nothing here describes a real organisation.

routine.quiet: If no rule has fired, the huddle confirms the roster and moves on.

rules.name: Roster no longer fits the forecast
rules.rule: For any of the next 7 days, the chance that required agents exceed rostered agents is 25% or more (or the roster is very likely more than 15% too large).
rules.response: Offer overtime or call in the flex pool for that day; if over-rostered, offer voluntary time off or move agents to training.

rules.check: Latest day against its expected range
rules.name: A day outside the expected range
rules.rule: The latest complete day falls outside the range expected the day before.
rules.response: Look for a known cause (weather, outage, city announcement) and log it. No roster change on one day alone.

rules.check: Last 7 days against their expected range
rules.name: A week outside the expected range
rules.rule: The last 7 days together fall outside the range expected a week ago.
rules.response: Re-base the forecast and review rosters for the next two weeks.

rules.check: Call topics against their expected ranges
rules.name: A call topic outside the expected range
rules.rule: A topic’s last 7 days together fall outside the range expected a week ago.
rules.response: Brief agents, update the phone-menu message and the knowledge article, and tell the agency that owns the topic.

triggered_rules.rule: Roster no longer fits the forecast
triggered_rules.defined_response: Offer overtime or call in the flex pool for that day; if over-rostered, offer voluntary time off or move agents to training.

triggered_rules.rule: A week outside the expected range
triggered_rules.defined_response: Re-base the forecast and review rosters for the next two weeks.

triggered_rules.rule: A call topic outside the expected range
triggered_rules.defined_response: Brief agents, update the phone-menu message and the knowledge article, and tell the agency that owns the topic.
